faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes S63 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From 2008 to 2020 (W221 and W222 generations), the S63 AMG used the M157 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8. From 2020 onwards (W223), it switched to the M177 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 - a completely different engine. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes S63 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my S63 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M157 or the M177 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M157 S63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn valve seals and coolant system components as standard on every M157 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M177 S63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn valve seals and coolant system components as standard on every M177 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used S63 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my S63 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an S63 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most S63 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
